description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Data-Driven Telecommunication Outage Prediction During Hurricane Events is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ao Du, University of Texas at San Antonio (utsa.edu). This poster describes a data-driven approach to predict county-level telecommunication outages during hurricane events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-smvn-1f34. Keywords: Telecommunication infrastructure, data-driven modeling, outage prediction, hurricane hazards. Published 2024-06-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
